principal.title: Principal Architect
principal.mission: Synthesize manager decisions, resolve conflicts, and select final architecture candidate.

leaf_experts.title: Requirement Intake Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Extract explicit requirements, constraints, assumptions, and unknowns.

leaf_experts.title: Domain Classifier Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Classify chip domain, workload, SoC class, and ambiguity level.

leaf_experts.title: Architecture Option Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Generate feasible architecture options without rewriting explicit requirements.

leaf_experts.title: CPU ISA Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Select CPU width, ISA profile, privilege assumptions, and extension constraints.

leaf_experts.title: CPU Pipeline Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Select pipeline depth, hazard assumptions, debug hooks, and implementation risks.

leaf_experts.title: Reset Boot Trap Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define reset, boot, trap, interrupt-entry, and ROM/RAM expectations.

leaf_experts.title: Memory Map Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Build address map intent, decode boundaries, and overlap risks.

leaf_experts.title: Memory Hierarchy Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define memory hierarchy, SRAM/ROM/cache assumptions, and coherency scope.

leaf_experts.title: Protocol AHB/APB/AXI Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Select primary protocol and preserve requested bus semantics.

leaf_experts.title: Bridge Adapter Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define required protocol bridge, boundary, and capability-gap policy.

leaf_experts.title: Interconnect QoS Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define interconnect topology, arbitration, QoS, and backpressure assumptions.

leaf_experts.title: Peripheral SPI Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Plan SPI external peripheral behavior, registers, interrupts, and DV hooks.

leaf_experts.title: Peripheral UART/I2C/GPIO Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Plan UART/I2C/GPIO behavior, registers, interrupts, and DV hooks.

leaf_experts.title: Register/SystemRDL Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Normalize register map, access policy, reset values, and SystemRDL needs.

leaf_experts.title: Firmware ABI Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define firmware-facing ABI, headers, driver stubs, and interrupt flow.

leaf_experts.title: DV Strategy Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define DV plan, scoreboards, coverage bins, and negative cases.

leaf_experts.title: Formal Property Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define formal-first properties, assumptions, and proof obligations.

leaf_experts.title: Physical Clock/Timing Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define clocks, resets, timing constraints, and implementation risks.

leaf_experts.title: Power Intent Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define power assumptions, clock gating, UPF needs, and unknowns.

leaf_experts.title: DFT/Testability Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define scan/test hooks, observability, controllability, and exclusions.

leaf_experts.title: Safety/Security Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define privilege, sensitive registers, misuse cases, and safety/security risks.

leaf_experts.title: IP Reuse/Cost Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Assess reuse, build cost, and unsupported feature risk.

leaf_experts.title: Downstream Agent Contract Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Define Agent2/3/4/5 handoff contract and capability gaps.

leaf_experts.title: Plan Readability/Diagram Expert
leaf_experts.mission: Ensure final plan is readable, diagrammable, and acceptance-driven.
